repository.description: Open-source Python SDK and automation toolkit for Epiphan KVM2USB 3.0 video capture and HID keyboard, mouse, and touch control.

project.purpose: Provide an independently written SDK, diagnostics, packaging, and research tooling for operating and understanding Epiphan KVM2USB 3.0 hardware through standard HID and UVC interfaces.
current_scope: Video capture through host UVC interfaces
Profile-driven HID discovery and input encoding
Keyboard, relative mouse, pen, and touch research
Portable Windows packaging and local deployment
out_of_scope_without_explicit_approval: Committing proprietary vendor binaries or restricted captures

related_repositories.relationship: Open hardware and USB identity coordination

evidence_policy.public_repository: Sanitized facts, independently written code, manifests, hashes, references, and conclusions only.
evidence_policy.restricted_evidence: Raw proprietary captures, vendor binaries, credentials, personal data, and decompiled vendor material must remain in an approved private evidence repository.
